records.text: The Henderson and Qureshi families both lived in the same house in Keller, Texas.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They were all living in the same house down in Keller, Texas, both the Henderson family and the Qureshi family. ... what is not up for debate is that both families were living in the same house down in Keller, Texas

verification.notes: Reliable company and community profiles connect the Henderson and Qureshi families through BILT, but no authoritative source was found establishing that both families lived in the same Keller, Texas house. People-search and address-aggregation pages are insufficient evidence and were not used to publish a private residential claim.
